chunks: Muhammad ibn Ishaq al-Maqri narrated from al-Maqani'i, from Bakkar ibn Ahmad, from al-Hasan ibn al-Husayn, from al-Ma'la ibn Ziyad, from al-Ala' ibn Bashir al-Muradi, from Abu al-Siddiq al-Naji, from Abu Sa'id al-Khudri, who said:

The Messenger of Allah (peace be upon him and his family) said: Give glad tidings of the Mahdi; he will be raised among my ummah amidst the discord and upheaval of the people. He will fill the earth with justice and equity, just as it was filled with injustice and oppression. The inhabitants of the heavens and the inhabitants of the earth will be pleased with him.

key_terms.اخْتِلَاف: Discord, division, or disagreement among people
key_terms.المَهْدِي: The Guided One, a title for the twelfth Imam in Shia eschatology

ai.seo_question: What are the signs and characteristics of Imam Mahdi's rise according to this hadith?
ai.summary: Recorded in Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Kitab al-Ghayba*, this hadith from Abu Sa'id al-Khudri serves as a foundational proof for the eventual appearance of Imam al-Mahdi, emphasizing his role in establishing global justice after an era of widespread tyranny. The narration highlights the cosmic significance of his rule, noting that both the inhabitants of the heavens and the earth will be pleased with him, a concept deeply rooted in Shia eschatology regarding the restoration of divine order.

en.sayyid-athar-husain-s-h-rizvi: H 136 - Muhammad bin Ishaq Muqri has narrated from Maqanai from Bakkar bin Ahmad from Hasan bin Husain from Mualla bin Ziyad from Alaa bin Bashir Muradi from Abu Siddiq Naji from Abu Saeed Khudri that he said:

The Messenger of Allah (s) said: I give glad tidings to you; Mahdi will rise up when people would be involved in discord and bewilderment. He would fill the earth with justice and equity just as it would be fraught with injustice and oppression in such a way that the inhabitants of the earth and the heavens would be pleased with him.
